title: Especialista Engenharia Mobile (React Native)
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
READ ME: To be considered for this role, please read the full post. Due to demand, we only review candidates who email with the requested details at the bottom. LinkedIn “Easy Apply” submissions will not be reviewed.


About Skip

Skip helps millions of entrepreneurs and small business owners access funding, grow faster, and build real businesses — all in one place. Our revenue is comparable to a high-growth Series B company and has doubled in the past two months. Over 1 million business owners trust Skip to simplify what used to be a maze of red tape.


Now we’re building the next evolution of entrepreneurship: an AI Cofounder that helps anyone start, run, and scale a business.


If you want to work on a product that touches real people — and directly helps them build their livelihoods — Skip is one of the most impactful places you can be.


The Role

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity engineering role.


As a senior full-stack engineer on our product and AI team, you’ll build new tools and experiences that give entrepreneurs real leverage — from conversational business planning to smart funding recommendations, automated documents, and personalized dashboards.


You’ll work directly with the founder and a tight product/design team. No bureaucracy. No layers. Just building, shipping fast, and seeing your work used by hundreds of thousands of people.


What You'll Do:

  • Build and ship new features using modern web technologies and AI APIs.
  • Integrate AI into user-facing flows — conversational builders, assistants, recommendations.
  • Contribute across Skip’s product stack: React/Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Supabase.
  • Rapidly prototype, test with real users, and iterate based on data and feedback.
  • Work closely with product, design, and support to uncover what actually moves the needle.
  • Help shape the architecture and UX of Skip’s AI Cofounder product.
  • (Optional/Secondary) Explore RAG, embeddings, or personalization systems — only if interested.


About You:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience , with strong experience shipping production features.
  • Strong with TypeScript and React/Next.js .
  • Comfortable across the stack or eager to work full-stack.
  • Curious about AI and excited to integrate AI capabilities into real products.
  • Communicative, proactive, and collaborative — you’re comfortable working closely with product and design.
  • You care about impact: you want your work to help real entrepreneurs build real businesses.


Why Join Skip?

  • You’ll be one of the core engineers shaping Skip’s AI Cofounder — a generational product shift.
  • You’ll work with an inspiring, high-output engineering/design team (including a strong Brazil engineering team).
  • You’ll have real ownership — not a feature factory, not endless specs.
  • You’ll see the impact of your work directly: from solo founders to growing teams across the U.S.
  • You’ll ship fast and learn fast.


Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $60,000–$80,000 USD equivalent (paid in USD or BRL)
  • Equity: 0.10%–0.40% — meaningful ownership in a fast-growing company
  • Paid time off + remote-first + autonomy to do your best work


How to Apply


Email:

Subject: Senior Software Engineer Position


Before emailing take a look through Skip including and share in 2-3 sentences why Skip's mission resonates with you and what's most important to you in your next role. You'll get a reply with next steps. We review all applications manually — no LinkedIn black hole.


We're building the future of entrepreneurship. Join us.

title: Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação
description:
Descrição


Sobre a NARI Brasil

A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.

Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.


Oportunidade

Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Proposta e Aplicação para compor nosso time Comercial em Sorocaba-SP. Se você possui experiência no setor de energia elétrica e está em busca de desafios, essa oportunidade pode ser interessante para você!


Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia elétrica;
  • Experiência no setor elétrico;
  • Experiência com propostas (especificações técnicas, estimativa de custos e impostos);
  • Inglês (nível avançado);
  • MS Office, AutoCAD (diferencial);
  • Carteira de motorista (tipo B).


Descrição das Atividades


  • Analisar os requisitos do cliente para projetar ou personalizar a solução técnica ideal (produto, sistema ou serviço) que atenda precisamente às necessidades do cliente;


  • Dimensionar equipamentos, realizar cálculos de engenharia e garantir que a solução seja tecnicamente efetiva;


  • Ser responsável por todo o documento da proposta, considerando: estimativa detalhada de custos, determinação dos prazos do projeto, tradução de dados técnicos, garantindo que a proposta final esteja em total conformidade com todas as especificações comerciais e técnicas;


  • Sincronizar as contribuições dos departamentos de vendas, engenharia, finanças e outros para garantir precisão e alinhamento.;


  • Fornecer suporte pré-venda, apresentando a proposta técnica ao cliente, alinhando todas as dúvidas e apoiando a equipe de vendas nas negociações contratuais.



Inscreva-se para essa oportunidade!

title: Adobe Campaign Engineer
description:
Adobe Campaign Engineer

Location: Remote (with EST hours overlap required)


About the Role: Join our dynamic team as the Senior Adobe Campaign Engineer. In this pivotal role, you will spearhead the implementation of Adobe Campaign Classic (V8) solutions, drive digital marketing excellence and guide a team of 2-3 junior Adobe engineers. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and optimize sophisticated marketing campaigns that deliver measurable business impact.


Key Responsibilities: - Lead the end-to-end implementation of Adobe Campaign Classic, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices. - Design, develop, and manage complex multi-channel marketing campaigns utilizing custom resources, real-time events, advanced workflows, content blocks, fragments, and typology rules. - Ensure the integrity, quality, and accuracy of customer data to enable precise targeting and segmentation. - Implement and optimize marketing automation processes to streamline campaign execution and maximize e iciency. - Leverage dynamic content and personalization strategies to enhance customer engagement and conversion rates. - Mentor and guide a team of junior Adobe engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment. - Collaborate with upstream and downstream systems using REST API services, ensuring seamless data integration and process automation. - Utilize your expertise in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to support campaign development and troubleshooting. Required Experience & Skills: - 5+ years of hands-on experience in digital marketing with a focus on Adobe Campaign Classic (V7/V8). - Deep understanding of Adobe Campaign Classic use cases, best practices, and campaign management intricacies. - Proven ability to design and execute complex marketing strategies in a fast-paced environment. - Strong technical proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST API integration. - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. - Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members. - Willingness and ability to work overlapping EST business hours until 11 AM EST. Nice to have: - Adobe Campaign Classic certification. - Experience in the financial services or lending industry. - Familiarity with additional Adobe Marketing Cloud solutions.

title: VENDEDOR EXTERNO JR
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A VITAFOR é uma das maiores empresas de suplementos alimentares do Brasil.


Desde o início trabalhamos para promover a saúde através da nutrição, mostrando que a suplementação é fundamental para o bem-estar humano.


Hoje, temos orgulho de ser “a marca mais premiada pelos profissionais da saúde e nutrição do país”, acumulando diferentes prêmios para o segmento.


Nossa fábrica, localizada na cidade de Araçoiaba da Serra – SP, é a maior e mais moderna do segmento, com laboratório de análises próprio, certificações nacionais e internacionais, além de boas práticas ambientais.


Responsabilidades:

Experiência anterior com vendas em PDVs, preferencialmente em farmácias, lojas de suplementos ou produtos naturais;

Habilidade em negociação e gestão de objeções, com foco em conversão e relacionamento com o cliente;

Capacidade para realizar pesquisas de mercado, identificando tendências, oportunidades e comportamento do consumidor;

Experiência em prospecção ativa de clientes e desenvolvimento de carteira.



Qualificações:

  • Superior Completo em Administração, Marketing, Nutrição, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com vendas em PDV; negociação comercial; prospecção.
  • Experiência com a atuação no segmento alimentar, farmacêutico com medicamentos, nutracêuticos.
  • Residir em Feira de Santana.
  • CNH B atualizada e disponibilidade para viagens e pernoite;

title: Engenheiro de Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente especializado(a) em Cloud e DevOps, com visão estratégica, autonomia técnica e paixão por construir ambientes escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance.

Se você domina AWS, automação e arquitetura moderna, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS com foco em segurança, governança e alta disponibilidade.
  • Desenvolver soluções de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform, CloudFormation e Ansible.
  • Implantar e manter ambientes com Kubernetes e Docker .
  • Construir pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI e ArgoCD.
  • Monitorar e aprimorar observabilidade com Datadog .
  • Automatizar processos com Python, Shell Script ou Go .
  • Aplicar práticas avançadas de Segurança da Informação : hardening, gestão de vulnerabilidades, WAF, IAM.
  • Atuar com FinOps , realizando análise de consumo e otimização de custos.
  • Executar práticas de resiliência e Chaos Engineering garantindo ambientes robustos.
  • Criar e manter APIs REST , integrações e rotinas de automação.
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis e baseadas em microsserviços.

title: Android Developer
description:
Intermediate Android (Kotlin) Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Remote : Brazil - 40 hours/wk

Rate : USD $15-19/hr


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience with Android Development, including the latest version of Android SDK
  • Ability to write clean code in Kotlin
  • Working experience with Android Jetpack and Design Patterns (MVVM , MVP, MVI)
  • Familiarity with RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs
  • Familiarity with building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines on GitHub actions


Nice to Have:

  • Other mobile development experience, including iOS development using Swift, or cross-platform development with React Native or Flutter


Job Description:

  • Designing and Building Apps: This involves translating design concepts and user requirements into functional Android applications.
  • Writing Code: Using programming languages like Java and Kotlin to create the app's logic, features, and user interface.
  • Working with the Android SDK: Utilizing the Android Software Development Kit (SDK) to access device features like the camera, GPS, and sensors.
  • Creating User-Friendly Interfaces: Designing intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces that are consistent with Android design guidelines.
  • Implementing App Navigation: Developing clear and logical navigation flows within the app.
  • Optimizing for Different Screen Sizes: Ensuring the app looks and functions correctly on a variety of Android devices with different screen sizes and resolutions.
  • Testing App Functionality: Conducting thorough testing to identify and fix bugs, errors, and performance issues.
  • Debugging Code: Using debugging tools to identify and resolve issues in the app's code.

title: Cientista de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Cientista de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você :

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

  • Programação;
  • Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

  • Python;
  • PySpark;
  • SQL.

Ferramentas:

Big Data:

  • HUE;
  • Hive;
  • Spark (SparkML);
  • NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

  • DB2;
  • MySQL;
  • Oracle;
  • Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).
  • Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)
  • Versionamento de código (Git)

Dashboards:

  • Spotfire;
  • Power BI.

Ciência de Dados

  • Manipulação de Dados;
  • Visualização de Dados;
  • Estatística;
  • Modelagem Preditiva;
  • Inteligência Artificial
  • IA Generativa
  • Machine Learning.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Assistente de Atendimento Operacional
description:
Venha fazer parte do nosso time como Assistente de Atendimento Operacional da Punto!


Estamos em busca de pessoas apaixonadas por atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe dinâmica! Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e pronta para fazer a diferença, essa vaga é para você!


O que você fará:


  • Prestar Suporte Direto ao Cliente: Seja por telefone, e-mail ou chat, você será a voz amigável que esclarece dúvidas e resolve problemas operacionais, garantindo que nossos clientes se sintam valorizados e bem atendidos.


  • Registrar e Monitorar Demandas: Você terá a responsabilidade de registrar e acompanhar as solicitações dos clientes, assegurando que todas sejam atendidas dentro dos prazos estipulados. Sua atenção aos detalhes será fundamental!

✨ Por que se juntar a nós?

Na Punto, valorizamos a excelência no atendimento e acreditamos que cada membro da equipe desempenha um papel crucial na criação de experiências memoráveis para nossos clientes. Se você está pronto para um novo desafio e deseja crescer em um ambiente colaborativo, queremos conhecer você!


Candidate-se agora e venha brilhar conosco!

title: React Software Engineer
description:
Title: React Software Engineer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type: Contract


Job Description:

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and stream-based processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle high through put workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support business critical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP


Responsibilities Include

  • This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including
  • Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs
  • Build and optimize message driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka
  • Develop scalable resilient APIs and backend services
  • Write clean maintainable and well tested code following industry best practices
  • Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments
  • Work closely with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations
  • Participate in code reviews system design discussions and operational readiness efforts
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure
  • Prototyping of new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineering velocity


Qualities Experience Were Seeking

  • We believe the right individual will have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role
  • A BS degree or higher in Engineering Computer Science or a related field is required
  • 5 years of software engineering experience
  • Strong Java experience in backend or distributed systems environments
  • Handson experience with Kafka producers consumers partitions topics offsets stream processing etc
  • Proficiency in Nodejs for backend application development
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services running in Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CICD
  • Handson experience with AWS and or GCP cloud platforms
  • Solid understanding of software design patterns system architecture and microservices principles
  • Experience working with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design performance considerations migrations
  • Strong debugging problem solving and communication skills
  • Excellent problem solving critical thinking and communication skills
  • Ability to work within a distributed team


Nice to have

  • VOD Streaming experience
  • Experience with React basic frontend integration work context management UI components
  • Exposure to infrastructure as code tools Terraform Helm etc
  • Monitoring observability tools Datadog NewRelic

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Engenheiro(a) de Dados . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados;
  • Sólido conhecimento em serviços da Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer etc.);
  • Forte domínio em modelagem de dados (dimensional e/ou Data Vault);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de pipelines estruturados, semiestruturados e streaming;
  • Proficiência em SQL avançado;
  • Experiência com Python para orquestração, transformação e automações;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git/GitLab), CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Entendimento de princípios de Data Governance, Data Quality e segurança de dados;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e atuação consultiva junto às áreas de negócio.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Liderança técnica de projetos de dados complexos;
  • Capacidade de definir arquiteturas escaláveis e padrões corporativos;
  • Experiência em ambientes altamente regulados ou com grande volume transacional;
  • Atuação prévia com integrações avançadas entre sistemas corporativos (ERP, sistemas legados, APIs, streaming);
  • Vivência em otimização de custo em plataformas de nuvem (cost efficiency);
  • Tomada de decisão técnica e influência sobre stakeholders de tecnologia e produto;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento de Pipelines de Dados: Projetar, construir e manter pipelines robustos, seguros e escaláveis em GCP, atendendo demandas analíticas, operacionais e regulatórias;
  • Modelagem e Estruturação de Dados: Criar modelos dimensionais, operacionais e/ou Data Vault que suportem análises consistentes e de alta performance;
  • Integração de Fontes Diversificadas: Implementar integrações entre sistemas corporativos, APIs, arquivos, eventos e fluxos de streaming (Pub/Sub), garantindo confiabilidade e rastreabilidade;
  • Gestão de Qualidade e Governança: Aplicar regras de qualidade, catalogação, linage e governança de dados, assegurando conformidade e segurança das informações;
  • Otimização e Performance: Monitorar, depurar e otimizar pipelines e consultas, reduzindo custos e garantindo SLA de processamento;
  • Atuação Consultiva: Ser o ponto de referência entre tecnologia e áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de dados eficientes, escaláveis e aderentes ao ambiente do cliente;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos, automatizar processos e propor inovações que elevem a maturidade analítica da empresa.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

title: ABAP Developer | Pleno
description:
CONSTRUA SUA CARREIRA NA GETNET!

Somos uma empresa global de tecnologia que fornece soluções de pagamento, fazemos parte da PagoNxt, o hub de pagamentos do Grupo Santander. Operando em mais de 10 países, nossa missão é imaginar, cuidar e simplificar, usando tecnologia e inovação para atender nossos clientes, desde pequenos empreendedores até grandes corporações, com soluções físicas e digitais para todos os tipos de negócios.

Vamos construir o futuro, juntos?

Estamos moldando o futuro dos métodos de pagamento, conectando comunidades e empresas de forma simples e eficaz. Essa jornada é conduzida por pessoas dedicadas a aprimorar constantemente nossas soluções. Aqui, imaginamos o amanhã, cuidamos do hoje e simplificamos o agora, construindo um futuro Wow!

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Sua missão em nosso time será:

  • Realizar suporte e manutenção aos ambientes produtivos e não produtivos implantados;
  • Efetuar análise de performance e troubleshooting propondo soluções;
  • Atender incidentes e problemas nos ambientes;
  • Implantar e documentar mudanças nos ambientes;
  • Executar checklists pró ativos para prevenção de problemas nos ambientes;
  • Desenvolver código clean, modular, seguro e testável seguindo melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Liderar e acompanhar a implantação das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Prover consultoria aos usuários em relação às soluções em operação;
  • Avaliar e garantir altos níveis de qualidade e performance das soluções desenvolvidas por terceiros;
  • Possuir conhecimento sobre os processos de negócio atendidos pela sua área de atuação;
  • Participar em projetos de Integração do SAP com sistemas legados;
  • Dominar técnicas de análise e especificação de requisitos de software.

title: Project Analyst
description:
SMT is a professional services and intelligence company specializing in technologies that transform how companies engage with their customers, employees, communities, and other stakeholders. Together with its partners, SMT implements the most robust global technologies in Experience Management. In today’s digital environment, experience has become increasingly critical for attracting, retaining, and engaging customers, talent, and influencers. Join our team as a Project Analyst and work on technology projects for global leaders!


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the implementation of technologies;
  • Training and guiding clients in the use of our technology services;
  • Configuring and optimizing surveys, dashboards, and automated workflows;
  • Conducting tests to ensure the quality and performance of all deliverables.


What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory;
  • Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn;
  • Passion for data, technology, and user experience;
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with diverse audiences.


What we offer:

  • 100% remote work with flexible hours;
  • CLT contract;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Life insurance;
  • Flash card (meal & food allowance);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Financial support for psychotherapy;
  • Access to learning and training platforms;
  • Annual bonus based on performance.


Note: Candidates must be fluent in English; those who are not will be disqualified automatically.

description:

Procuramos profissionais que atuem com Engenharia Cloud AWS para atuação remota.


Responsabilidades:


  • Atuar no desenho de arquiteturas AWS focadas em automação, padronização e esteiras CI/CD.
  • Suporte a projetos de migração, modernização, IaC e ambientes Kubernetes/ECS.

  • AWS Core Services (EC2, IAM, VPC, S3, CloudWatch).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking multiple remote, full-time Senior Software Engineers with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in Ruby on Rails or Golang, as well as SQL, to join our U.S. client's engineering organization. You will build and maintain clients' software product lines to ensure they deliver value efficiently and reliably for their customers.

No two days are the same; you'll never stop learning and growing. You'll have the autonomy to make important decisions about systems and processes while receiving support and guidance along the way.

You will enjoy working in a flexible remote environment where mutual respect is a key ingredient. The team is supportive, highly talented, and always encouraged to communicate ideas with the executive team. The client's Engineering team is critical to the company's continued success and would like to thank you for your feedback.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Develop clean, efficient, and well-documented code using modern software development practices
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues impacting uptime, stability, or performance
  • Profile and optimize code, database queries, and API interactions to improve response times and scalability
  • Collaborate with Product and QA teams to enhance reliability and maintainability of core systems
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and performance tuning initiatives
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the full SDLC from incident prevention to automated testing and deployment


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of strong experience as a software engineer in a SaaS or cloud-based environment
  • Strong computer science foundation in algorithms
  • Experience working on enterprise web application development
  • Experience with Ruby and or/Golang
  • Experience with relational databases, such as SQL Server
  • Experience with JavaScript libraries
  • Proficiency with developing SaaS-based applications for any central cloud platform
  • Proficiency with Agile methods, Git, or continuous integration
  • Highly adaptable, capable of learning new technologies
  • Knowledge of the HTTP protocol as well as web services written in SOAP, XML-RPC, REST, or equivalent technologies
  • Understanding of good unit and functional test writing
  • Familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in energy industry software, particularly upstream or midstream workflows
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer

You will build and maintain clients' software product lines to ensure they deliver value efficiently and reliably for their customers.

No two days are the same; you'll never stop learning and growing. You'll have the autonomy to make important decisions about systems and processes while receiving support and guidance along the way.

You will enjoy working in a flexible remote environment where mutual respect is a key ingredient. title: Cloud Architect
description:
About the company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to join our team.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a secure, governed, and cost-transparent AWS Landing Zone, leveraging AWS Control Tower to establish a consistent, well-architected cloud foundation. This foundational work will support the client's future initiatives in data analytics, AI, and workload management.
  • Lead Discovery & Planning workshops.
  • Design the multi-account strategy and VPC network architecture.
  • Perform the entire Implementation (deploying Control Tower, core security services, and IaC artifacts).
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Highly skilled in AWS design, Control Tower, security best practices, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)
  • In-Scope Deliverables:
  • Comprehensive Landing Zone Architecture and Implementation Plan.
  • Deployment of a production-grade AWS Landing Zone configured via Control Tower.
  • Implementation of core security services: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and AWS Config.
  • Deployment of automated compliance controls via selected Conformance Packs.
  • Integration of IAM Identity Center (SSO) using Office 365 IdP.
  • All Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) artifacts (Terraform/CloudFormation templates).



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services

title: Linguist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing (Language: Portuguese, Location: Brazil)

Experience Level: Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Linguistics or a related field.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.

Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.

title: Java Specialist
description:
QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years in the industry, is seeking a highly skilled Java Specialist to join our global engineering team. We deliver world-class technology solutions to clients across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and collaboration.


This is a full-time, 100% remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to work directly with our US-based customer while collaborating with cross-functional, distributed teams.

Advanced English proficiency is mandatory, as you will communicate daily with US stakeholders.


About the Role


We are looking for an expert-level Java/Spring Boot Specialist who can contribute to technical decisions, uphold engineering standards, and collaborate across backend and frontend components.

You will work with Solution Architects, BAs, DevOps, and full-stack developers across complex financial and operational domains, including Billing, Ledger, Invoice, and Remittance.


Although the focus of this role is deep Java expertise , experience with AI-assisted development (e.g., GPT, Claude) is a strong plus for candidates who already use or are interested in learning AI tools to enhance productivity.


Required Qualifications


  • Expert-level experience in Java and Spring Boot (core requirement).
  • Strong experience with Node.js , React , and PostgreSQL .
  • Experience with security , DevOps , Cloud , and the GitHub ecosystem .
  • Familiarity with GitHub Advanced Security, GitHub CI/CD pipelines, and versioning best practices.
  • Solid experience with AWS IAM and hands-on work with EC2, RDS, SQS .
  • Ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Experience working with complex business domains or enterprise-level systems.
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory


Nice to Have


  • Experience (or interest in learning) AI-assisted development workflows using LLMs like GPT or Claude for:
  • Code generation
  • Code review
  • Code refactoring
  • Prompt-based engineering patterns
  • Experience leading or mentoring distributed teams.
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • Familiarity with modern architectural patterns and high-scale systems.

title: Desenvolvedor de Backend .NET
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Líder global em soluções transacionais , conecta empresas, empregados e comerciantes há mais de 50 anos. Atua em três frentes: Benefícios e Engajamento , Mobilidade e Soluções de Pagamentos e Novos Mercados . Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Pleno para atuar na equipe de Infraestrutura. Buscamos alguém com experiência na função , que tenha vontade de aprender continuamente e trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe .

O projeto envolve o desenvolvimento de uma nova plataforma , composta por APIs, processadores e um portal , utilizando .NET 6 e ReactJS .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Projetar, desenvolver e apoiar na implantação de sistemas e aplicações conforme as tecnologias e padrões definidos.
  • Desenvolver código limpo, organizado e bem testado, alinhado às boas práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Atuar em um ambiente ágil, multidisciplinar e colaborativo.
  • Participar de todas as cerimônias do processo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento de releases até a entrega e implantação das soluções.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência com Microserviços , C# , ASP.NET , .NET Architecture e Web Services ;
  • Banco de dados SQL Server ;
  • Conhecimentos em HTML , JavaScript , Docker e Kubernetes .


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com DHTML , Web Design , XSLT , Visual Basic e Crystal Reports ;
  • Conhecimento ou experiência com UML , RUP e especificação de casos de uso ;
  • Vivência no setor financeiro será um diferencial.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno ou Sênior


Perfil:

Profissional com postura hands on, forte atuação em código e experiência em ambientes on-premise .


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Python:
  • Domínio da linguagem e capacidade de integração com outras ferramentas.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas como pandas, entre outras.
  • Airflow:
  • Criação de DAGs e manutenção de fluxos.
  • Integração com dbt-core .
  • DBT:
  • Criação e manutenção de modelos.
  • Migração de códigos SQL para DBT.
  • Nifi:
  • Capacidade de construção e manutenção de fluxos
  • Git:
  • Estruturação de deploys em camadas, alinhado com a área de Infraestrutura.
  • SQL Server:
  • Conhecimento intermediário.
  • Tuning, avaliação de performance, otimização e demais operações.


  • Inglês:
  • Nível mínimo B2.
  • Arquitetura Medallion:
  • Conhecimento sobre operações da arquitetura.
  • Não é necessário ter experiência em implementação.




E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Python com IA
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência sólida com Python;

- Experiência com Java e Quarkus;

- Conhecimento em JavaScript + Angular;

- Vivência com OCR (processamento e leitura de documentos);

- Uso de Docker para empacotamento e deploy;

- Experiência com AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambdas, S3, Ec2);

- Monitoramento com Grafana;

- Conhecimento de ferramentas de IA aplicadas, como LangChain e Langfuse;

- Fundamentos de IA, NLP (Linguagem Natural), Machine Learning e Deep Learning;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados;

- Vivência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

- Conhecimento em UX conversacional e UI para interfaces com IA.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
About the Role:

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to support founders and leadership teams with daily operations, communication, and project execution. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role where you’ll act as an extension of the founder’s operational capacity, keeping things organized, moving, and aligned. You’ll handle coordination, communication, and light creative work while helping maintain structure across multiple projects and priorities.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage calendars, schedules, reminders, and day-to-day priorities
  • Support internal and external communication on behalf of the founder or leadership team
  • Assist with project management: tracking tasks, organizing workflows, and ensuring deadlines are hit
  • Conduct research and prepare summaries, briefs, and follow-up documentation
  • Provide light design support using Canva (presentations, templates, visuals)
  • Maintain organized systems, files, and SOPs to keep operations smooth and efficient


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Ability to manage multiple moving parts and follow through consistently
  • Proactive mindset, someone who anticipates needs and solves problems before they arise
  • Comfort with light design work (Canva or similar tools)
  • Professional, composed, and able to represent the founder with discretion
  • Bright, resourceful, and adaptable in fast-paced environments

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and onboard world-class creative and production talent. You’ll help build the global network that powers SoCreative — sourcing videographers, photographers, designers, editors, motion specialists, creative leads, project managers, and other key roles across time zones.


This role is perfect for someone who’s organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys connecting great people with great opportunities. If you’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and love building strong talent pipelines, you’ll thrive here.


What you’ll do

  • Source and attract top creative, production, and operations talent across global markets
  • Manage the full recruitment cycle — from job posting to screening, interviews, assessments, and onboarding
  • Build strong talent pools for high-demand roles (design, video, motion, PM, creative leads)
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and refine talent profiles
  • Conduct structured interviews and evaluate candidates for skills, experience, and culture fit
  • Maintain organised, up-to-date applicant pipelines and recruitment dashboards
  • Implement scalable sourcing strategies using LinkedIn, job boards, communities, referrals, and outreach tools
  • Maintain clear, timely communication with candidates to ensure a positive experience
  • Help improve hiring processes, documentation, and workflows as we grow


What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or sourcing (creative, agency, or tech experience preferred)
  • Strong sourcing skills and familiarity with modern recruitment tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, AI sourcing tools, etc.)
  • Ability to assess creative and operational talent across multiple specialties
  • Clear and confident communication in English, able to manage candidate expectations and present opportunities effectively
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working across multiple roles at once
  • A positive, collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment


Why join SoCreative?

We help brands like American Express, Johnson & Johnson, Google, Schneider Electric and Toyota scale video and design content with speed, consistency, and creativity. We’re a creative company built for quality and flexibility — powered by smart tech, streamlined systems, and a global network of top-tier talent.


You’ll join a supportive, fast-moving team that values clear communication, creative thinking, and getting things done. If you’re eager to grow, take initiative, and help shape a modern creative operation — we’d love to hear from you!

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

title: Intermediate Full Stack Developer
description:
Intermediate Full Stack Developer

Contract : 3 months + extensions

Rate : USD $13-17/hr

Fully Remote: Brazil - 40 hours/wk


Required Skills:

  • 3-5+ years of professional experience as a full stack developer (excluding internships)
  • Expertise in React.JS and Node.JS, with the ability to right clean code.
  • Comfortable with command line (Mac)
  • Experience with GraphQL and Apollo


Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Familiarity with AWS & Docker
  • Experience with NextJS
  • Familiar with SSR applications and their requirements
  • Experience with Styled Components
  • Experience with ecommerce platforms, e.g. Shopify Plus, CommerceCloud, Hybris, etc.


Job Description:

You use modern tools and frameworks (REACT and Node.js) and can code up an application from scratch and spin up a cloud infrastructure to host it. You have a clear understanding of security and build it into any of your services. Although you have the full support of your teammates, you are able to participate in the research and solution of complex problems. At the same time, you know when to ask for help and don’t let pride or ego get in the way, because after all, you are part of a team. “Initiative” is your middle name, and you don’t give us a chance to chase you. We are on the hunt for people who have an innovative mindset (you still dream of that moonshot project but are currently working on your side-gig)!


Designing and developing user interfaces (UIs): This involves translating design mockups into actual web pages using HTML, CSS, Component Libraries, and React with Typescript.

  • Creating responsive and interactive web pages: Ensuring websites look good and function smoothly on all devices (desktops, tablets, and phones).
  • Optimizing website performance: Making sure websites load quickly and efficiently.
  • Writing server-side code: Using languages like Javascript, Typescript on Node.js to handle data storage, retrieval, and processing.
  • Developing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces): Creating interfaces that allow different applications to communicate with each other.

title: Analytics Engineer Sênior
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) / Analytics Engineer


A ATRA está em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a) para atuar na construção, organização e otimização de pipelines analíticos, modelos de transformação, governança de dados e camadas de consumo. Essa função combina engenharia, analytics e visão de produto — ideal para profissionais que transitam com fluidez entre dados, negócio e tecnologia.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir pipelines de transformação utilizando DBT com testes, documentação e boas práticas.
  • Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines complexos em Airflow.
  • Criar e otimizar estruturas em BigQuery com foco em performance e eficiência de custos.
  • Desenvolver dashboards e análises em Looker Platform, garantindo coerência entre métricas e modelos.
  • Atuar próximo a times de produto, dados e negócio para traduzir necessidades em soluções analíticas.
  • Garantir organização, padronização e governança das camadas de dados.
  • Automação de processos e validações utilizando Python (quando aplicável).
  • Acompanhar, investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados a dados e pipelines.
  • Documentar processos, modelos e padrões de forma clara e escalável.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) Analítico(a), Engenheiro(a) de BI ou função similar.
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, incluindo modelagem relacional e dimensional.
  • Experiência avançada com DBT para construção e gestão de pipelines de transformação.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • GCP – BigQuery : conhecimento profundo de performance, otimização de custos e recursos avançados.
  • Familiaridade com serviços de dados do GCP (ex.: Cloud Storage).
  • Experiência com Looker Platform para criação de dashboards e análises.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis/Consultivos)

  • Perfil consultivo: capacidade de dialogar com áreas não técnicas e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade para análise de causa-raiz e construção de insights.
  • Cultura forte de documentação, governança e padronização de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises exploratórias.
  • Conhecimento em métricas de negócio (Opcional): AARRR, LTV, CAC, métricas financeiras.


Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, autonomia e alto rigor técnico.
  • Visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Proatividade para propor melhorias estruturais.


Modelo de Trabalho e Contratação

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido ou Remoto (ajustável conforme projeto)


Benefícios ATRA

  • TotalPass
  • Reembolso 100% em certificações
  • Parcerias educacionais
  • Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas
  • Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA: Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: Contract/PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js.
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka.
  • Develop scalable, resilient APIs and backend components.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following best engineering practices.
  • Deploy, monitor and operate applications in Kubernetes across AWS and/or GCP.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams on system components and integrations.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design sessions, and operational readiness activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure.
  • Prototype new technologies to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase engineering velocity.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering.
  • Strong expertise in Java (backend, microservices, distributed systems).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, offsets, stream processing).
  • Proficiency in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience deploying services on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Practical experience with AWS and/or GCP.
  • Solid understanding of design patterns, system architecture, and microservices.

title: Operations Analytics Manager
description:
Job Description:

You will deliver insights using quantitative data to support our operations business. You will work closely with inventory, logistics, retail, and customer services team within the ops org, and partner with tech and finance teams working with nearly all aspects of our growing business. You will collaborate with operations analysts to understand, measure, and optimize efficiency in our operations, provide clarity of business performance, identify growth opportunities, and drive alignment to focus on the most impactful areas for our company.


What You Get To Do Every Day:

Understand and quantify operational efficiency metrics.

Design, implement, and report on item data throughout our receiving, authentication, launch and outbound flow.

Provide key product health measurements and reporting to support the business on a daily basis

Communicate product insights to business partner teams and leadership.


Minimum Requirements:

English - Mandatory

5+ years years analytics experience

Expert in SQL

5+ years of experience with BI tools such as microstrategy, tableau, looker etc.

Expert in translating between practical problems and technical formulations and solutions

Proven ability to design and implement time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, strategic recommendations, and presentation of the findings

Proven track record of thriving with ambiguity


Preferred Requirements:

eCommerce or logistics industry experience preferred

title: US Immigration Consultant
description:
Reporting to: Founders


Company Description


Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform created by immigrants to support the U.S. mobility needs of technologists, artists, and skilled professionals.


Our mission is to streamline the immigration process using innovative tools and resources to empower global talent. Beyond Border is dedicated to fostering inclusivity, bridging gaps, and making global career transitions as seamless as possible.


Our first product is to help tech operators and founders navigate U.S. immigration with ease. We work with Founders and skilled executives to make their U.S. immigration journey seamless.


We are profitable, and are trusted by clients hailing from Microsoft, Google, Meta, Amazon, Klarna, Chime and more.


Role Description

The US Immigration Consultant role is a full cycle sales role from prospecting to closing.


You should have at least 1 year of experience working in US high skilled immigration pathways, including O-1, L-1, EB-1 or EB2-NIW categories.


Legal professionals who have a track record of managing client intakes are welcomed to apply as well.


You will be working with a seasoned operator team that has experience building businesses from Seed to IPO, hailing from Wework, Glints, Square Peg, Apps For Bharat, Solifi and Line Data before.


Qualifications

  • You must have at least 1+ year of US immigration experience, OR
  • You must have managed B2C sales before with a track record of surpassing quota for at least 4 consecutive quarters

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Mobility Care Associate


Job Type: Full-time, Overnight Freelancer Position

Location: Remote - Brazil - Work from home

Hours: Set Schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


**** This schedule is set and will not change ****


**** Resumes must be submitted in English ****


On behalf of our client, we are seeking a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with excellent communication skills to join the Mindglobal team as a Mobility Care Associate .

Mindglobal , listed in Gartner's 2021 Market Guide, offers corporate TEM (Telecom Expense Management) solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises around the world. They are adding new members to their Brazilian team.


Position Overview

As a Mobility Care Associate for Mindglobal , you are responsible for providing customer and technical assistance and support related to mobile device systems, hardware, software, company and carrier processes, and client procedures. You will respond to queries by inbound phone call, email and as assigned, respond in a timely and professional manner, isolate issues and requests, and determine and implement a resolution as per client specific company procedures.


This position is responsible for general customer service and completion of our clients’ day-to-day tasks within measurable SLA metrics.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly and professionally answer inbound client calls according to each client’s preferred greeting and nomenclature
  • Respond to requests for assistance sent by email and received by our Helpdesk Ticketing solution professionally and using appropriate templates, verbiage and guidelines, and within each client’s desired response SLA
  • Understand, access, and efficiently use carrier portals and other tools
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported hardware, Mindglobal tools and carrier systems
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues involving clients’ supported MDM and related systems, Mindglobal published client- and inside-facing tools, and carrier portals
  • Research process, policy and procedure questions using available informational resources
  • Using appropriate and professional grammar and communication skills, advise client employees on appropriate action(s), timelines, outcomes, etc.
  • Follow Mindglobal’s standard help desk procedures according to each client’s agreements, preferences and processes as noted in the KB, and as may be advised by MCM/CM and Helpdesk management
  • Ensure 100% of your client-related work is entered, tracked and documented in our Helpdesk Ticketing system correctly
  • Provide guidance to clients’ employees on proper use of Mindglobal specific websites and tools
  • Understand and explain client-specific processes and procedures as well as carrier specific data to clients’ employees
  • Refer and redirect non-Helpdesk requests to appropriate resource(s)
  • Identify and escalate situations requiring urgent attention and to the most appropriate resource
  • Stay current with industry trends, mobile technologies, internal systems and information, changes and updates
  • Proper and appropriate use of PC/Laptop and related equipment for Mindglobal’s purposes
  • Proper and appropriate use of Mindglobal’s electronic tools and resources for Mindglobal’s purposes


Who you are:

  • Proficient and professional/native level English speaker and writer
  • Able to multi-task and juggle a large volume of tasks
  • Consistently reliable: able to be on time and present when scheduled
  • Professional behavior in the workplace, remotely, and anywhere your Mindglobal affiliation is known
  • Excellent communication skills – verbal and written
  • Self-motivated to be effective with minimal supervision
  • Detail, process and results oriented
  • Ability to avoid distraction and consistently work throughout a scheduled shift
  • Previous experience in mobile/wireless industry a plus


What Mindglobal offers:

  • Career Growth – Mindglobal prioritizes internal promotions.
  • Remote Flexibility – Work from home in Brazil.
  • Company Culture – A collaborative and supportive team environment.


Job Type: Full-time, Contract position

This is a freelancer position. Benefits (such as healthcare, paid time off or 13th month pay) are not provided. You will be an independent direct contractor ("freelancer") with Mindglobal and paid hourly for time worked. You will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week and as a contractor can choose your time off and holidays.


Compensation & Hours:

Pay: $6.60 USD per hour - This amount of hourly pay is only associated with this “overnight” shift as it includes an overnight pay differential.


Hours: Set schedule Monday – Friday, 3pm - 12am CST


Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas


Idioma:

  • English (Obrigatório)

title: SAP BTP CAP/RAP
description:
Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) SAP com sólida experiência em extensões na SAP BTP, utilizando CAP e RAP, para atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de soluções cloud nativas integradas a ambientes SAP (ECC/S/4HANA).

Vaga hibrida qualquer cidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações e extensões na SAP BTP utilizando CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Implementar APIs, serviços OData/REST, lógica de negócio e integrações com sistemas SAP on-premise e cloud.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de aplicações existentes, realizando correções, melhorias e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo na área de TI (Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou cursos correlatos).
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento SAP.
  • Experiência sólida com SAP BTP e desenvolvimento utilizando CAP (Node.js/Java) e RAP (ABAP RESTful).
  • Bom domínio de ABAP OO, modelos de dados SAP, CDS Views, OData e conceitos de clean core.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de desenvolvimento moderno (code review, testes, pipelines básicos).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa comunicação em times distribuídos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Certificações SAP em BTP, CAP, RAP ou S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5, integrações com APIs externas e eventos (Event Mesh, Kafka, etc.).


O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • Benefícios TCS – Brasil
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Planos Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Totalpass
  • TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados
  • Parceria com SESC
  • Reembolso de Certificações
  • Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo
  • Oportunidade de experiência internacional
  • Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas
  • Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação
  • TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance
  • Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita
